title: Open Node in S Opens App
description: When opening a node in s it should open the app. Currently nothing happens and you stay stuck in s studio.
summary: Opening a media-graph node in s stayed on studio because applyHostEffects overwrote ensureSpawnedPlugin's activeSpawnedId. Fold spawn/focus into nextViewState via studioPanelFocusingSpawned + viewStateWithStudioPanel before the final SET_SESSION; cover with vitest; leave [DEBUG] openPluginInstance log for runtime confirmation.
